Two ways to bound the transcript cache; the benchmark picks the second.

## Benchmark
| Strategy | p50 load | RAM |
|---|---|---|
| Cap by count | 120 ms | 64 MB |
| Cap by bytes | 95 ms | 32 MB |

## The change
```ts
export const MAX_CACHE_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
```

## Caveat
A single transcript larger than the cap is never cached, so opening it is as slow as before.
